info.title: ElecSarthi Backend REST API
info.description:
Complete OpenAPI 3.0.3 specification audited directly against the ElecSarthi Spring Boot 4.2.0 backend.

### Roles & Client Channel Isolation
- **Web Console (`clientType: WEB`):** `OWNER`, `SUBOWNER` (max 3 concurrent web sessions, 30 min sliding idle, 12 h absolute).
- **Mobile App (`clientType: MOBILE`):** `AGENT`, `CUSTOMER`, `SUBUSER` (device-bound ECDSA P-256, max 1 concurrent session per user, 90 d absolute, 30 d refresh).

### Mobile Device Signature Protocol
All authenticated `MOBILE` calls to `/api/v1/voters/**`, `/api/v1/turnout/**`, `/api/v1/sync/**`, `/api/v1/leases/**` (plus `POST /api/v1/auth/refresh`, and any request carrying `X-Device-Signature`) require ECDSA P-256 (`SHA256withECDSA`) headers.
Canonical signing payload (7 newline-separated lines):
`METHOD\nURI_PATH\nSHA256_HEX(rawBodyBytes)\nTIMESTAMP_EPOCH_MS\nNONCE\nCOUNTER\nCONTEXT_ID`
- For `POST /api/v1/auth/refresh`, `SHA256_HEX(rawBodyBytes)` is replaced with `SHA256_HEX(refreshToken)`.
- Omit query string from `URI_PATH`. `CONTEXT_ID` is `X-Device-Context-Id` or empty string `""`.

### Frontend Audit Notes
- Standard errors use `ErrorResponse` (`{ code, message, timestamp }`); `DeviceSignatureFilter` 401 errors currently emit `{ errorCode, message }`.
- Unauthenticated requests to protected routes currently return HTTP `403` (empty body) because no custom `AuthenticationEntryPoint` is configured.
- `POST /api/v1/auth/logout` should only be called with a valid token (calling without auth currently triggers NPE 500).
- `SyncChunkResponse.isLastChunk` serializes in JSON as `lastChunk`.

post.description: Authenticates user credentials and enforces channel separation (`WEB` -> `OWNER`/`SUBOWNER`, `MOBILE` -> `AGENT`/`CUSTOMER`/`SUBUSER`). If a mobile user has no `ACTIVE` device, returns `deviceRegistrationRequired: true` with a single-use `registrationToken` (5 min TTL) instead of access/refresh tokens. If an `ACTIVE` device already exists and `installationId` does not match, returns 403 `DEVICE_CHANGE_NOT_ALLOWED`.

Exchanges a mobile refresh token (`sessionId.generation.secret`) for a new access token and rotated refresh token. All 5 device proof headers are mandatory; signature signs `SHA256_HEX(refreshToken)` instead of the JSON body. Reusing an older refresh token immediately terminates the session (`REFRESH_TOKEN_REUSE`).
Terminates the caller's active session (`USER_LOGOUT`). Requires a valid `ACCESS` bearer token.

Activates a `PENDING` Customer account using their E.164 phone number, 10-character Crockford Base32 activation code, and new password (min 8 chars). Returns a single-use `registrationToken` to register the Customer's mobile device. Max 5 attempts (`ACTIVATION_MAX_ATTEMPTS_EXCEEDED`), 72-hour code TTL (`ACTIVATION_CODE_EXPIRED`).

Allowed roles: `AGENT`, `CUSTOMER`, `SUBUSER`. Accepts either a single-use `REGISTRATION` token or an `ACCESS` token. Rejects with 403 `DEVICE_CHANGE_NOT_ALLOWED` if an `ACTIVE` device already exists. Returns `deviceId` and 64-hex `challenge` valid for 2 minutes.

Allowed roles: `AGENT`, `CUSTOMER`, `SUBUSER`. Verifies the Base64 DER `SHA256withECDSA` signature over the UTF-8 `challenge` string, promotes the device to `ACTIVE`, and atomically invalidates the `REGISTRATION` token JTI.

Revokes a device, terminates its active sessions (`DEVICE_REVOKED`), and cascade-revokes active offline leases. Authorization matrix: `OWNER` (any device), `SUBOWNER` (`AGENT` devices only; 404 otherwise), `AGENT` (own customers & their subusers only; 403 for own device, 404 for other agents' customers), `CUSTOMER` (own organization `SUBUSER` devices only; 403 for own primary device, 404 for other customers).

get.description: Allowed roles: `OWNER` (any user), `SUBOWNER` (`AGENT` accounts and own profile only; other accounts return 404).

patch.description: Allowed roles: `OWNER` (any user), `SUBOWNER` (`AGENT` accounts only). Suspending a user immediately terminates their sessions.

post.description: Allowed roles: `OWNER` (any user), `SUBOWNER` (`AGENT` accounts only). Sets `mustChangePassword=true` and terminates existing active sessions.

post.summary: Terminate all active sessions for a user
post.description: Allowed roles: `OWNER` (any user), `SUBOWNER` (`AGENT` accounts only).

Allowed roles: `OWNER`, `SUBOWNER`, `AGENT`. Creates `customer_account` and `PENDING` `CUSTOMER` login (username = `contactPhone`), and returns a one-time 10-character Crockford Base32 activation code (72h TTL). When called by an `AGENT`, `owningAgentUserId` is forced to the caller.

get.description: Allowed roles: `OWNER` (all, unmasked phones), `SUBOWNER` (all, `contactPhone` masked as `+91*****1234`), `AGENT` (own customers only, unmasked phones).
Allowed roles: `OWNER`, `SUBOWNER` (`contactPhone` masked), `AGENT` (own customers only; 404 otherwise), `CUSTOMER` (own account only; 404 otherwise).

post.description: Allowed roles: `OWNER`, `SUBOWNER`, `AGENT` (own customers only). Only valid while `activationStatus == PENDING`. Resets attempt counter to 0.
Suspends the customer account, terminates active sessions for customer & subusers, revokes offline leases, and increments `mobileAccessPolicyVersion`.

post.summary: Upload and ingest .xlsx voter dataset (Owner or Subowner)
post.description: Multipart streaming upload (`max-file-size: 200MB`, `max-request-size: 210MB`). Send `file` as binary `.xlsx` and `metadata` as an `application/json` part matching `DatasetUploadRequest`. Note: `importedByUsername` may be `null` in the 201 upload response and populated on `GET /api/v1/datasets/{id}`.

get.summary: Get dataset details and import issues (Owner or Subowner)

delete.summary: Delete dataset and drop partitions (Owner or Subowner)
delete.description: Blocked with 409 `CANNOT_DELETE_DATASET` if active entitlements or unexpired offline leases exist.

200.description: List of election types with field definitions

get.summary: Get election type by code or ID
List configured fields for an election type
Query cascading sale-form filter options (Owner, Subowner, Agent)
get.description: Returns distinct values for `target` from `IMPORTED` datasets of the specified `tier` usable by the election type. Pass previously selected cascading parent filter values as additional query parameters (e.g. `?tier=MASTER&target=ac_no&state=RAJASTHAN`).

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Optional additional cascading parent filter key/value pairs (e.g. `state=RAJASTHAN&district=JAIPUR`)

post.description: Allowed role: `AGENT` only. Sells time-limited area access to the Agent's own active Customer. Supports idempotent replay via `idempotencyKey` (409 if reused with modified payload). Resolves dataset internally (`AREA_UNAVAILABLE`, `AREA_MULTIPLE_DATASETS`, `AMBIGUOUS_AREA` guards). Never exposes `datasetId`.
Marks sale `VOIDED`, revokes linked entitlements, revokes active offline leases, bumps customer policy version, and recomputes `LONG_TERM` retention.

get.summary: Get sale details (Owner or owning Agent)
List sales for a Customer (Owner or owning Agent)

post.description: Creates a `DIRECT` entitlement (`saleLineId: null`). Note: enabling `mobileAccess` on creation or via toggle is governed by Owner rules.

put.summary: Toggle voter mobile access on an entitlement (Owner only)

get.description: Allowed roles: `OWNER`, `SUBOWNER`, `AGENT` (own customers only), `CUSTOMER` (own customer account only).
Allowed roles: `OWNER`, `SUBOWNER`, `AGENT` (own customers only), `CUSTOMER` (own entitlements only).

get.summary: Get quantity-only sales report (Owner or Agent)
get.description: `SUBOWNER` is strictly forbidden (403). `OWNER` sees all sales or filters by `agentId`; `AGENT` sees own sales only. Contains zero pricing/commission fields.

post.summary: Search voters within active entitlement scope (Customer or Subuser + Device Signature)
post.description: Paginated voter search (`page` defaults to `0`, `limit` defaults to `50`, clamped `[1, 100]`). `sortBy` and `sortDirection` are accepted but ignored (always sorted by booth ASC, serial_no ASC). `SUBUSER` callers are restricted to assigned booths. `mobileNumber` is unmasked only when global toggle is true AND caller is `CUSTOMER` AND `entitlement.mobileAccess` is true.

get.summary: Get voter details (Customer or Subuser + Device Signature)
get.description: Projects only columns configured for the entitlement's election type (additional columns returned in `additionalFields`). Out-of-scope voter IDs return 404.

get.summary: Get family members (Customer or Subuser + Device Signature)
get.description: Returns voters sharing the same booth and non-blank `houseNo` within scope (empty list if `houseNo` is blank).

get.summary: Get voter slip data (Customer or Subuser + Device Signature)
get.description: Formats voter slip header and `slipFields` from `election_type_field` entries where `on_slip = true`.

put.summary: Toggle global voter mobile number visibility (Owner only)
put.description: Persists `GLOBAL_MOBILE_TOGGLE` to `audit_log` and increments `mobile_access_policy_version` on active customers.

get.summary: Get global voter mobile visibility setting (Owner or Subowner)

post.summary: Mark voter as voted (Customer or Subuser + Device Signature)
post.description: Idempotent first-mark-wins (`ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`) returning stored `markedAt` timestamp.

post.summary: Unmark voter turnout (Customer only + Device Signature)
post.description: `SUBUSER` is strictly forbidden (403).

post.summary: Reset turnout for entitlement or booth (Customer only + Device Signature)

get.summary: Get turnout statistics (Customer or Subuser + Device Signature)
get.description: Returns overall totals, booth breakdown, and gender breakdown. Subusers are scoped to assigned booths (403 if requesting an unassigned `boothNo`).

post.description: Note: `contactPhone` in `CreateSubuserRequest` is accepted in JSON but not persisted.

parameters.name: customerAccountId
parameters.description: Used only when caller is `OWNER` to inspect a specific Customer's subusers

post.description: Assigns booth to slot `1` or `2` (max 2 active slots, max `durationDays` = 7, bounded by entitlement expiration).
Revokes an active booth assignment, freeing the slot and cascade-revoking linked offline leases.

post.summary: Start offline bulk sync session (Customer only + Device Signature)
post.description: `SUBUSER` is strictly forbidden (403). `protocolVersion` is optional (defaults to `1`).

get.summary: Retrieve sync chunk (Customer only + Device Signature)
get.description: Revalidates user, customer, device, entitlement, and session expiration on every chunk.

post.summary: Complete sync session (Customer only + Device Signature)
Request signed offline booth lease (Subuser only + Device Signature)
post.description: Issues an Ed25519-signed lease capped at `min(assignment.validUntil, entitlement.validUntil, now + 24h)`. Contains no voter data.

post.summary: Submit offline turnout marks (Subuser only + Device Signature)
post.description: Enforces strict interval `issuedAt <= offlineMarkedAt < expiresAt` and active assignment/entitlement/device/customer/subuser checks.

bearerAuth.description: Normal `ACCESS` JWT returned by `POST /api/v1/auth/login` or `POST /api/v1/auth/refresh` (15-minute TTL).

registrationBearerAuth.description: Single-use `REGISTRATION` JWT (5-minute TTL) strictly scoped to `/api/v1/devices/register` and `/api/v1/devices/verify`.

XDeviceIdRequired.name: X-Device-Id
XDeviceIdRequired.description: Registered device UUID bound to the active mobile session.

XDeviceIdOptional.name: X-Device-Id
XDeviceIdOptional.description: Registered device UUID; if provided, must match the authenticated session's deviceId.

XDeviceSignatureRequired.name: X-Device-Signature
XDeviceSignatureRequired.description: Base64-encoded DER `SHA256withECDSA` signature over the canonical 7-line request payload.

XDeviceTimestampRequired.name: X-Device-Timestamp
XDeviceTimestampRequired.description: Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds (validated within +/- 5 minutes of server time).

XDeviceNonceRequired.name: X-Device-Nonce
XDeviceNonceRequired.description: Unique single-use nonce per device (stored 10 minutes to prevent replay).

XDeviceCounterRequired.name: X-Device-Counter
XDeviceCounterRequired.description: Strictly increasing monotonic integer counter (> `lastRequestCounter` on device).

XDeviceContextIdOptional.name: X-Device-Context-Id
XDeviceContextIdOptional.description: Optional context identifier included as the 7th line of the signed canonical payload.

Unauthorized.description: Invalid credentials, expired/reused refresh token, or invalid device signature (`ErrorResponse` or `DeviceFilterErrorResponse`)

Forbidden.description: Role/tenant permission denied (or missing/expired bearer token on protected routes)

NotFound.description: Resource not found or concealed out-of-scope tenant resource

Conflict.description: Duplicate record, overlap constraint, session limit, or active entitlement delete guard

PayloadTooLarge.description: Multipart upload exceeded 200MB file / 210MB request limit

DeviceFilterErrorResponse.description: Error shape emitted directly by `DeviceSignatureFilter` on HTTP 401.

deviceSignature.description: Optional device proof signature when replacing session on same device

publicKey.description: Base64-encoded X.509 ECDSA P-256 public key

challengeSignature.description: Base64 DER `SHA256withECDSA` signature over UTF-8 challenge string

owningAgentUserId.description: Optional for Owner/Subowner; ignored/overridden when caller is Agent

name.description: Partial voter name match (English or local language)

sortBy.description: Accepted for compatibility; server currently ignores and sorts by booth/serialNo

boothNo.description: Optional booth filter; resets entire entitlement area if omitted

contactPhone.description: Optional; currently accepted in payload but not persisted

refreshToken.description: Present only for `MOBILE` logins when device is already registered

challenge.description: 64-hex challenge string to sign with device ECDSA P-256 private key

activationCode.description: Returned once at provisioning; never stored in plaintext

additionalFields.description: Configured election-type-specific columns (e.g. Panchayat/Zilla/Samiti/Ward fields) in display order

payloadJson.description: Canonical JSON payload signed by server Ed25519 key

serverSignature.description: Base64 Ed25519 signature over SHA-256 of `payloadJson`
